ownership.businessAuthority: App discovery, installation, developer submission, app review, and extension marketplace flows.

observabilityAuthority.audit: app install, submission, and review actions must be audit-correlated

executionAuthority.executionRole: Thin composition runtime for routing, rendering, presentation adapters, and runtime-specific transport.
executionAuthority.orchestrationRole: No durable business orchestration; delegate workflows to application-services and backend services.
executionAuthority.infrastructureOwnership: No provider SDK or direct infrastructure adapter ownership; consume provider integrations through runtime-composition adapters or service API contracts.
executionAuthority.eventOwnership: May forward correlation IDs and display event-derived state; does not own durable event processing.
executionAuthority.queryOwnership: May consume runtime-composition query layers and API responses; page-level read aggregation must migrate to packages/runtime-composition.
executionAuthority.compositionOwnership: Owns user-facing runtime composition and presentation for its actor boundary.

orchestrationAuthority: No durable business orchestration; routes and pages delegate workflows to packages/application-services and read composition to packages/runtime-composition.
eventAuthority: No durable event ownership; may propagate correlation metadata and render event-derived state received from service APIs.
workflowAuthority: Workflows, use cases, sequencing, and cross-domain coordination are owned by packages/application-services, not this runtime.
queryAuthority: Consumes packages/runtime-composition query layers and service API responses; does not own aggregation pipelines or projection assembly.
compositionAuthority: Owns actor-specific rendering, routing, presentation adapters, and runtime composition only.
executionOwnership: Routing, rendering, runtime adapters, presentation transport, and runtime hooks only.
distributedExecutionOwnership: No distributed execution ownership; durable event persistence, queues, checkpoints, replay, and coordination delegate to service execution containers and packages/distributed-runtime.
queueOwnership: No queue execution ownership; durable queue production and consumption delegate to service execution containers and queue workers.
providerOwnership: None; provider execution must go through services or packages/infrastructure adapters consumed behind approved runtime-composition or service API boundaries.
executionBoundaries: Thin runtime boundary: routing, rendering, presentation adapters, runtime transport, and runtime hooks only.
asyncExecutionOwnership: No durable async ownership; async workflows, queues, replay, and retries delegate to services, application-services, and orchestration runtimes.
observabilityOwnership: Propagates request and correlation IDs through rendering and transport adapters; durable trace, audit, and event telemetry are written by backend execution containers.
telemetryOwnership: No durable telemetry pipeline ownership; propagates request and correlation metadata while trace, metric, log, and span persistence delegate to service runtimes and packages/distributed-runtime.
workflowRecoveryOwnership: No workflow recovery ownership; recovery planning delegates to packages/application-services and packages/orchestration through service APIs.
recoveryOwnership: No runtime recovery ownership; workflow, replay, queue, and projection recovery delegate to services, packages/application-services, packages/orchestration, and packages/distributed-runtime.
replayOwnership: No event replay ownership; replay lifecycle delegates to service execution containers and packages/orchestration.
checkpointOwnership: No checkpoint ownership; workflow, replay, queue, and projection checkpoints delegate to service runtimes using packages/distributed-runtime and packages/projection-runtime.
projectionOwnership: No projection assembly ownership; read projections, aggregation, and response shaping delegate to packages/runtime-composition.
cqrsOwnership: No CQRS command or projection persistence ownership; command sequencing delegates to application-services and read models delegate to runtime-composition/projection-runtime.
cacheOwnership: No durable cache coordination ownership; app fetch/cache hints delegate invalidation and projection cache policy to runtime-composition, projection-runtime, and service execution containers.
coordinationOwnership: No distributed coordination ownership; leases, locks, fencing tokens, heartbeats, and leader election delegate to service runtimes using packages/distributed-runtime.
resilienceOwnership: No resilience policy ownership; provider retries, circuit breakers, fallback execution, and degradation handling delegate to service runtimes, packages/distributed-runtime, and packages/infrastructure.
regionalOwnership: No regional execution ownership; region-aware routing, tenant affinity, and failover delegate to Cloudflare/service runtime boundaries and packages/distributed-runtime.
tenantScalingOwnership: No tenant workload governance ownership; quotas, partitioning, noisy-neighbor protection, and runtime metrics delegate to service execution containers and packages/distributed-runtime.
auditOwnership: No execution audit ownership; privileged actions and durable execution audit trails delegate to service runtimes and packages/distributed-runtime.
operationalOwnership: No operational runtime ownership; deployment, recovery, diagnostics, and control-plane execution delegate to service runtimes and packages/distributed-runtime.
telemetryExecutionOwnership: No telemetry execution ownership; apps propagate trace and request metadata while service runtimes execute spans, metrics, and structured log persistence.
replayExecutionOwnership: No replay execution ownership; replay scheduling, authorization, dry-runs, and rollback coordination delegate to service execution containers.
queueExecutionOwnership: No queue execution ownership; durable queue inspection, recovery, redrive, retry, and dead-letter operations delegate to queue worker and API service runtimes.
resilienceExecutionOwnership: No resilience execution ownership; circuit breakers, adaptive retries, degraded mode, failover, and provider recovery execute in service runtimes and infrastructure adapters.
regionalExecutionOwnership: No regional execution ownership; region routing, tenant affinity, replication diagnostics, and failover execution delegate to service runtimes and deployment topology metadata.
auditExecutionOwnership: No audit execution ownership; runtime audit persistence and operational security telemetry delegate to backend service runtimes.
cacheExecutionOwnership: No cache execution ownership; cache invalidation, consistency checks, replay invalidation, and lifecycle metrics delegate to runtime-composition, projection-runtime, and service runtimes.
coordinationExecutionOwnership: No distributed coordination execution ownership; worker leases, fencing tokens, leader election, and ownership transfer delegate to service runtimes using packages/distributed-runtime.
diagnosticsOwnership: May surface user-safe diagnostics returned by service APIs; runtime diagnostics persistence and incident metadata delegate to operational service runtimes.
operationalControlPlaneOwnership: No operational control-plane ownership; replay, workflow, queue, resilience, telemetry, tenant, and recovery commands delegate to platform service runtimes.
deploymentOwnership: Owns presentation runtime deployment participation for App Marketplace; deploys through provider promotion gates and delegates infrastructure execution to service runtimes.
observabilityInfrastructureOwnership: Emits correlated runtime telemetry to the OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Tempo, Loki, and Grafana stack declared in infrastructure/observability.
queueProviderOwnership: Delegates production queue provider execution to services/api-gateway producers and services/queue-workers consumers.
eventStoreOwnership: Delegates event persistence to packages/distributed-runtime contracts backed by Supabase Postgres append-only event store.
failoverOwnership: Participates in active/passive failover through deployment topology, health checks, and service-owned runtime fallback.
incidentOwnership: Participates in incident metadata, diagnostics, alert routing, and audit records through production incident governance.
deploymentTopologyOwnership: Must match config/runtime/deployment-topology.json and config/runtime/production-topology.json; topology drift is a hard validation failure.
securityOwnership: Uses provider environment stores and authenticated service APIs; no service-role or provider secrets may enter client runtime.
chaosOwnership: Participates in approved chaos experiments recorded in chaos_experiment_runs with guardrails and rollback commands.
loadTestingOwnership: Participates in k6/Gatling/Locust production-readiness benchmarks recorded in load_test_runs.
controlPlaneOwnership: Uses operator UI/API surfaces for control-plane visibility and delegates execution to service runtimes.
regionalRoutingOwnership: Uses global-edge routing and delegates stateful regional execution to service and data runtimes.
productionOwnership: Delegates production execution to service APIs, provider platforms, deployment topology, and runtime manifests while owning presentation availability.
deploymentPipelineOwnership: Delegates deployment pipeline gates through infrastructure/deployment, production-rollout workflow, health gates, rollback runbooks, and production topology validation.
telemetryInfrastructureOwnership: Delegates telemetry infrastructure integration through OpenTelemetry, runtime telemetry tables, Prometheus alerts, and dashboard projections.
dashboardOwnership: Delegates operational dashboard projection exposure through platform-console operations UI and Grafana dashboards without local mock data.
operationalDashboardOwnership: Delegates operational dashboard projection exposure through platform-console operations UI and Grafana dashboards without local mock data.
sreOwnership: Delegates SRE ownership for SLOs, error budgets, escalation paths, readiness scoring, and incident runbook participation.
replayOperationsOwnership: Delegates replay execution, authorization, checkpointing, and recovery to services/event-bus, services/api-gateway, and distributed-runtime packages.
